message.content:
The illustration on a magazine cover features several people against a red background shaped like a virus with multiple rounded protrusions. In the upper-center, a man in a white shirt and light-blue mask raises a rectangular metal cleaver high above his head. Below him, five other figures wearing light-blue masks are depicted. To the left, a woman in a white blouse looks down at an open laptop. On the right, a woman in a white coat holds a transparent cylindrical container. At the bottom, a person in a grey baseball cap sits near a brown cardboard box, a man in a light-blue t-shirt holds white bags filled with groceries, and a woman in an apron stirs a pot with a ladle.

Large white block letters across the middle read "SOLIDARITAS MELAWAN CORONA." Above this, the word "TEMPO" appears in large black letters. Text at the top includes "TIPU-TIPU KOPERASI INDOSURYA" and "BELAJAR DARI SEJARAH WABAH NUSANTARA." A paragraph on the left begins with "DI TENGAH PANDEMI COVID-19..." and ends with "KE SELURUH NEGERI." The bottom left includes a barcode, QR code, "18-24 MEI 2020," and "RP 45.000."
